note: Happiness, fan support and the Shop (track-viewer/docs/career-mode.md, Part 3). Happiness and fan support are meters 0-100 about the driver's life: they move sponsor pay, XP, trust gains, offers and the press, and never the car or a rival's pace. 'round' is what one race week adds to happiness, then it drifts back to 50 by 'drift' of the gap. Item ids are the names of the Shop images at /assets/ui/shop/<id>.webp. Starting values, tuned with scripts/career-sim.mjs.

bands.name: On top of the world
bands.does: Sponsors pay 10 % more, XP +5 %, friendly press

bands.name: Frustrated
bands.does: Sponsors pay 5 % less, trust grows at half speed

bands.name: Unhappy
bands.does: Fewer offers, a sponsor may walk, harsh press. You can demand a transfer

types.name: Luxury
types.note: Buy any time. A big lift now, a smaller glow every round, a yearly upkeep. A second one counts for less.

types.name: Parties
types.note: Takes the week's activity slot. A quick lift, and a chance the pictures get out.

types.name: Time off
types.note: Takes the week and skips its optional event.

types.name: Giving back
types.note: Takes the week's slot. Costs money, wins fans.

types.name: Sponsor ad deals
types.note: Pays you, and takes the week and its optional event. Bigger deals need more reputation.

items.name: City apartment
items.line: A place of your own near the garage.

items.name: Penthouse
items.line: Top floor, private lift, a view of the circuit.

items.name: Mansion
items.line: Gates, a garden and a garage for the trophies.

items.name: Collector's watch
items.line: A serious watch with a serious price.

items.name: Supercar
items.line: A road car that is nearly as quick as the team's.

items.name: Yacht
items.line: Moored in the harbour, with a crew of six.

items.name: Night out
items.line: Friends, a table at the back, no cameras (you hope).

items.name: Big party
items.line: Half the paddock on the guest list.

items.name: Huge bash
items.line: A hired hall, a band, the whole Tour.

items.name: Holiday
items.line: A week somewhere warm with the phone off.

items.name: Luxury holiday
items.line: Seven days of sun and no timing screens.

items.name: Fan day
items.line: Autographs, selfies and a lap in the team van.

items.name: Charity gala
items.line: An evening of auctions for a good cause.

items.name: Ad shoot
items.line: A day in front of the lights for a sponsor.

items.name: Billboard deal
items.line: Your face on a wall across the Tour.

items.name: TV commercial
items.line: Thirty seconds on prime time, three days of takes.
